<select id="selectDeviceForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.asset.dal.dataobject.device.DeviceDO">
        SELECT id,
               sn,
               project_id,
               project_assignment_version,
               customer_id,
               customer_assignment_version,
               tenant_id
        FROM ast_device
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND id = #{query.deviceId}
          AND deleted = b'0'
        FOR UPDATE
    </select>

<select id="selectCurrentProject" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.asset.dal.dataobject.assignment.DeviceProjectRelationshipDO">
        SELECT id,
               device_sn,
               project_id,
               relationship_type,
               effective_from,
               effective_to,
               assignment_version,
               reason,
               operation_id,
               source_system,
               source_key,
               source_version,
               version,
               tenant_id
        FROM ast_device_project_relationship
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND device_sn = (
              SELECT sn
              FROM ast_device
              WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                AND id = #{query.deviceId}
                AND deleted = b'0'
          )
          AND relationship_type = 'DIRECT'
          AND effective_to IS NULL
          AND deleted = b'0'
        LIMIT 1
    </select>

<select id="selectContractIds" resultType="java.lang.Long">

        WHERE c.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND c.contract_no=#{query.contractNo}
          AND c.deleted=b'0' AND r.deleted=b'0' AND r.status='ACTIVE'
          AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= #{query.at})
          AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > #{query.at})
    </select>

<select id="selectOrderIds" resultType="java.lang.Long">

          AND (source_system='ERP' OR (source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS')
            AND source_record_key LIKE CONCAT('DPPMS|',source_system,'|%')))
          AND source_record_key=#{query.sourceKey} AND deleted=b'0'
    </select>

<select id="selectLineIds" resultType="java.lang.Long">

<select id="selectAssociatedOrderIds" resultType="java.lang.Long">
        SELECT DISTINCT o.id FROM com_sales_order o
        JOIN com_contract c ON c.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.contract_no=#{query.contractNo}
        JOIN com_project_contract_relation pcr ON pcr.contract_id=c.id AND pcr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND pcr.deleted=0
        WHERE o.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND pcr.project_id=#{query.projectId}
          AND o.deleted=0 AND o.status='ENABLED' AND (o.source_system='ERP' OR o.source_system=#{query.source})
          AND o.order_no=#{query.number} AND o.order_type=#{query.type}
          AND pcr.status='ACTIVE'
          AND (pcr.effective_from IS NULL OR pcr.effective_from <= #{query.at})
          AND (pcr.effective_to IS NULL OR pcr.effective_to > #{query.at})
          AND (
            (CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY))

<select id="selectCursorPage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.platform.dal.dataobject.migration.MigrationSourceRecordDO">
        SELECT s.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m
                                WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND m.result_type = 'MAPPED' AND m.deleted = b'0') THEN 'MAPPED'
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_migration_issue i
                                WHERE i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND i.deleted = b'0') THEN 'ISSUE'
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m
                                WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                                  AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') THEN 'RETAINED'
                   ELSE NULL
               END AS result_type
        FROM plt_migration_source_record s
        WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND s.batch_id = #{query.batchId}
          AND s.deleted = b'0'
          <if test="query.afterSourceRecordId != null">
              AND s.id > #{query.afterSourceRecordId}
          </if>
        ORDER BY s.id ASC
        LIMIT #{query.limit}
    </select>

<select id="selectClassificationSummary" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.platform.dal.mysql.migration.query.MigrationBatchClassificationSummary">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped), 0) AS mapped_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_issue), 0) AS issue_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_retained), 0) AS retained_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained = 0), 0) AS unclassified_count,
               COALESCE(SUM(has_mapped + has_issue + has_retained > 1), 0) AS conflicting_count
        FROM (
            SELECT s.id,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_external_mapping_result)
                           WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND m.result_type = 'MAPPED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_mapped,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_migration_issue i FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_migration_issue_key)
                           WHERE i.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND i.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND i.deleted = b'0') AS has_issue,
                   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_external_key_mapping m FORCE INDEX (uk_plt_external_mapping_result)
                           WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.source_record_id = s.id
                             AND m.result_type = 'RETAINED' AND m.deleted = b'0') AS has_retained
            FROM plt_migration_source_record s FORCE INDEX (idx_plt_migration_source_cursor)
            WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
              AND s.batch_id = #{query.batchId}
              AND s.deleted = b'0'
        ) classified
    </select>

        ORDER BY c.execution_no,c.item_group,c.bom_path,c.id LIMIT #{query.offset},#{query.limit}
    </select>

<select id="countProject" resultType="java.lang.Long">
        SELECT COUNT(*) <include refid="displayCacheScope" />
    </select>

<select id="selectPathNodes" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.associated.ProjectProductConfigurationDO">
        SELECT * FROM proj_project_product_configuration
        WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=b'0'
          AND project_code=#{query.sourceProjectCode}
          AND CAST(project_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.sourceProjectCode} AS BINARY)
        <choose>
            <when test="query.paths.size() > 0">
                AND (
                <foreach collection="query.paths" item="path" separator=" OR ">
                    (CAST(project_code AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{path.projectCode} AS BINARY)
                     AND CAST(execution_no AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{path.executionNo} AS BINARY)
                     AND item_group <=> #{path.itemGroup}
                     AND CAST(bom_path AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{path.bomPath} AS BINARY))
                </foreach>
                )
            </when>
            <otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise>
        </choose>
    </select>

<select id="selectRecordForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.associated.ProjectRealProductDO">
        SELECT * FROM proj_project_real_product WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId}
          AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.id} FOR UPDATE
    </select>

<select id="selectBusinessRecordsForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.associated.ProjectRealProductDO">
        SELECT * FROM proj_project_real_product WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}
          AND CAST(contract_no AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.contractNo} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(project_code AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.projectCode} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(execution_no AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.executionNo} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(product_category_name AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.productCategoryName} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(product_name AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.productName} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(product_sub_code AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.productSubCode} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(product_sub_model AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.productSubModel} AS BINARY)
          AND CAST(product_sub_name AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.productSubName} AS BINARY)
          AND quantity <=> #{query.quantity}
          AND CAST(memo AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{query.memo} AS BINARY)
        ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
    </select>

<select id="selectSourceLicenseRecords" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.legacydetail.ProjectLegacyRecordDO">
    SELECT r.* FROM proj_legacy_detail_record r
    JOIN proj_legacy_detail_snapshot s ON s.id=r.snapshot_id AND s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
    WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.source_id=#{query.sourceId}
      AND r.domain_code='licenses'
    <if test="query.afterId != null">AND r.id>#{query.afterId}</if>
    ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{query.limit}
  </select>

<select id="selectEndDateForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMasterDO">
        SELECT * FROM proj_project WHERE id = #{query.projectId} AND tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
    </select>

<select id="selectListByIdsForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMasterDO">
        SELECT *
        FROM proj_project
        WHERE id IN
        <foreach collection="ids" item="id" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{id}
        </foreach>
          AND deleted = b'0'
        ORDER BY id
        FOR UPDATE
    </select>

<select id="selectVisiblePage" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.project.dal.dataobject.projectmanual.ProjectMasterDO">
        SELECT p.*
        FROM proj_project p
        WHERE p.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND p.deleted = b'0'
          AND p.id IN
          <foreach collection="query.visibleProjectIds" item="projectId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
              #{projectId}
          </foreach>
          <if test="query.projectNameKeyword != null and query.projectNameKeyword != ''">
              AND p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.projectNameKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCodePrefix != null and query.projectCodePrefix != ''">
              AND p.project_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.projectCodePrefix}, '%')
          </if>
          <choose>
              <when test="query.status != null and query.status != '' and query.status.matches('S[0-6]')">
                  AND p.current_stage = #{query.status}
                  AND p.lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE'
              </when>
              <otherwise>
                  <if test="query.status != null and query.status != ''">
                      AND p.lifecycle_status = #{query.status}
                  </if>
              </otherwise>
          </choose>
          <if test="query.signingMethod != null and query.signingMethod != ''">
              AND p.signing_method = #{query.signingMethod}
          </if>
          <if test="query.projectCategory != null and query.projectCategory != ''">
              AND p.project_category = #{query.projectCategory}
          </if>
          <if test="query.implementationMode != null and query.implementationMode != ''">
              AND p.implementation_mode = #{query.implementationMode}
          </if>
          <if test="query.majorProjectLevel != null and query.majorProjectLevel != ''">
              AND p.major_project_level = #{query.majorProjectLevel}
          </if>
          <if test="query.contractNoKeyword != null and query.contractNoKeyword != ''">
              AND p.contract_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractNoKeyword}, '%')
          </if>
          <if test="query.departmentId != null">
              AND p.department_id = #{query.departmentId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.companyId != null">
              AND p.company_id = #{query.companyId}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeStart != null">
              AND p.create_time >= #{query.createTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.createTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.create_time < #{query.createTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_close_time >= #{query.closeTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.closeTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_close_time < #{query.closeTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeStart != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time >= #{query.refreshTimeStart}
          </if>
          <if test="query.refreshTimeEnd != null">
              AND p.project_refresh_time < #{query.refreshTimeEnd}
          </if>
          <if test="query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != null and query.agentServiceProviderKeyword != ''">
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_party pp
                  WHERE pp.project_id = p.id
                    AND pp.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                    AND pp.deleted = b'0'
                    AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE'
                    AND (pp.effective_from IS NULL OR pp.effective_from <= #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND (pp.effective_to IS NULL OR pp.effective_to > #{query.effectiveAt})
                    AND pp.party_role IN ('AGENT', 'SERVICE_PROVIDER')
                    AND (pp.party_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%')
                      OR pp.party_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.agentServiceProviderKeyword}, '%'))
              )
          </if>
        ORDER BY p.id DESC
    </select>
